subject.title: fix(clickclack): recover when API requests stall

question: Should ClickClack control-plane REST calls adopt the proposed 30-second header and body-idle budgets as the supported compatibility contract for existing deployments?
rationale: The implementation is focused and tested, but choosing a new user-visible failure budget for slow servers and reverse proxies is an owner policy decision rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Confirm the 30-second contract
options.body: Merge the current bounded, progress-aware policy if ClickClack deployments are expected to return headers and body progress within 30 seconds.

options.title: Choose a different documented budget
options.body: Ask for a targeted update to the constants and regression expectations if ClickClack's supported proxy or server behavior needs a longer control-plane allowance.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 30-second contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current bounded, progress-aware policy if ClickClack deployments are expected to return headers and body progress within 30 seconds.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current timeout policy and accompanying regression coverage; current-main area ownership was not available in the supplied history.
